accepted_services.location: Köpmansgatan 10, 22100 Mariehamn; applications can be submitted electronically or on paper.
accepted_services.regular_time: Applications are processed continuously during the year; the organisation aims to reply within one month. The office may be closed and no grants made during holidays and school breaks.
accepted_services.free_and_conditions: Free grant support for children aged 0–17 and their families in financial hardship or temporary crisis. The fund generally does not replace goods or services that municipalities or the state are legally required to provide.
